listing.name: Doom / PsyDoom (BodbDearg)
listing.summary: Play PlayStation Doom and Final Doom through PsyDoom using your own game-disc image.

steps.title: Keep the Windows player together
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Windows x64 ZIP into a separate folder. If the player requires it, follow upstream’s Windows Visual C++ runtime prerequisite.

steps.title: Choose your PlayStation game disc
steps.instruction: Finish setup with PsyDoom.exe and its folder. On Play, use the launcher to select a supported PS1 Doom or Final Doom .cue file, keeping all referenced track files with it. A PC Doom WAD does not replace that disc image.

steps.title: Preserve your working copy
steps.instruction: Updates remain with you and upstream. Keep original disc files and mods backed up. Windows settings, saves and demos normally use AppData/Roaming/com.codelobster/PsyDoom; also preserve a local launcher.ini or custom files if your copy uses them.
